project_type: mahalo-agentcore — Bedrock AgentCore/Strands rewrite of mahalo-dock. Task 3 reimplements the four mahalo-dock mock systems (Jira, Confluence, GitHub, ServiceNow) as AWS Lambda functions behavior-equivalent to the local mocks, with AWS CDK (Python) IaC. Zero LangChain. Gateway/MCP wiring is Task 4 (out of scope).
language: Python 3.13 (python 3.13.9 confirmed). PowerShell scripts for ops.
build_system: No monorepo build. Two independent Python venvs created by this task: tools-lambdas/.venv (Lambda unit tests: pytest + moto) and infra-cdk/.venv (aws-cdk-lib 2.x + constructs + pytest). Both .venv/ are gitignored. Node v24.13.0, aws-cdk 2.1145.0 installed globally. Lambda assets carry NO third-party runtime deps (boto3/botocore come from the Lambda runtime) and NO per-service requirements.txt; test-only deps live in tools-lambdas/requirements-dev.txt and are never packaged.
test_framework: pytest. Lambda tests use moto @mock_aws to fake DynamoDB (offline, no AWS creds). CDK tests use aws_cdk.assertions.Template (synth, no AWS creds). No pytest.ini/pyproject — tests run by path.
build_command: Lambda import smoke: & "tools-lambdas/.venv/Scripts/python.exe" -c "import pytest, moto; print('deps OK')" . CDK synth (closest thing to a build): cd infra-cdk; .\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1; cdk synth --all .
test_command: Lambda: & "tools-lambdas/.venv/Scripts/python.exe" -m pytest tools-lambdas/tests -q (run from repo root). CDK assertions: cd infra-cdk; & .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tests -q .
verification_instructions: Run everything from the repo root D:/<USER>/LavaCode/AI/mahalo-agentcore with the matching venv python. Shell is Windows PowerShell: chain with ';' NOT '&&'; env vars are $env:VAR; invoke a venv exe with the call operator &. Offline bar for FEAT-001: `& tools-lambdas/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tools-lambdas/tests -q` passes with no network. contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING/.kiro steering files exist in this repo. Conventions inferred from the existing agent/ package and the task2 FEAT artifacts: byte-for-byte fidelity to mahalo-dock contracts; create a dedicated venv per component (mirrors agent/.venv); tests mirror the source structure; artifacts live under docs/.agents/tasks/. The APPROVED design docs/.agents/tasks/task3-design.md is AUTHORITATIVE for every endpoint/verb/body/status/detail/id-rule/auth decision — do not redesign; port verbatim.
key_patterns: Agent HTTP seam (agent/tools/http.py make_request) treats ONLY 200/201 as success; any other status becomes {"error": "Request failed with status {code}: {text}"}. github_create_branch (agent/tools/github_write_tools.py) treats error text containing 'status 409'/'status 422'/'already exists' as SUCCESS — so the Lambda MUST return the native 409/422 + exact mock `detail` strings ('Branch already exists', 'head branch is required', "Field '{x}' is required", 'Repository not found', 'Branch not found', 'Repository already exists'). Auth: case-insensitive header-KEY lookup for x-api-token, EXACT value compare (header != expected -> 401 {"detail":"Invalid API token"}, incl. None/absence). ID generation mixes rules per field: MAX-based (jira story {proj}-{max+1}; servicenow INC-{max(2000,max)+1}; github PR `number` max+1) vs COUNT-based (github commit c{count+1:03d}; github PR id pr-{count+1}; confluence page {space}-{count+1:03d} before .upper()); count = DynamoDB Query Select=COUNT over the collection pk (== mock len()). GitHub keys ALL collections by seed repo id `repo-N` (never name); three separate collections REPO/BRANCHSET/STATS back three distinct 404 checks (create_repo writes REPO+BRANCHSET but NOT STATS). Validation order: required-field 422 BEFORE existence 404 (mirrors pydantic running first). DynamoDB model: one table per service (mahalo-mock-<svc>), pk=collection name, sk=natural id, record under `data` attr (github dict-keyed BRANCHSET/STATS store list under `value`), lazy seed via conditional-put sentinel pk=_meta/sk=seeded.
